title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision
authors: Alec Radford, Jong Wook Kim, Chris Hallacy, Aditya Ramesh, Gabriel Goh, Sandhini Agarwal, Girish Sastry, Amanda Askell, Pamela Mishkin, Jack Clark, Gretchen Krueger, Ilya Sutskever
annotation: Makalah pengenal model fondasi CLIP yang memelopori pra-pelatihan kontrastif multimodal citra-teks dan klasifikasi zero-shot berskala masif.

title: Masked Autoencoders Are Scalable Vision Learners
authors: Kaiming He, Xinlei Chen, Saining Xie, Yanghao Li, Piotr Dollár, Ross Girshick
publisher: IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR)
annotation: Karya penting dalam pemodelan citra bermasker (MIM) menggunakan arsitektur ViT asimetris dan masking rasio tinggi 75% untuk pra-pelatihan representasi visual mandiri.

authors: Maxime Oquab, Timothée Darcet, Théo Moutakanni, Huy V. title: A Simple Framework for Contrastive Learning of Visual Representations
authors: Ting Chen, Simon Kornblith, Mohammad Norouzi, Geoffrey Hinton
annotation: Arsitektur SimCLR yang mendefinisikan standar modern augmentasi data visual terpadu, proyeksi non-linier, dan optimasi fungsi rugi InfoNCE.
